{{Top|leg}}
The '''Chanzari Den''' was a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Den (Selonian)|den]] native to [[Selonia/Legends|Selonia]] who was allied with the [[Hunchuzuc Den]] and the [[Republicanists]]. When [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], [[Dracmus]] and [[Salculd]] crashed their [[Selonian cone ship|Coneship]], they were fortunate enough to land on a Chanzari-controlled land. Like the Hunchuzuc, they were most likely tricked into submission by the [[Overden]] and the [[Sacorrian Triad]], who had lied about who had true control over Selonia's [[planetary repulsor]].
